featured.name: Endometriosis Survey Engine
featured.desc: Self-hosted replacement for Google Forms, made for a nursing-school thesis. Surveys are rows in the database, not code. It has two languages, an SVG body map for marking pain, and autosave with resume. The graded awareness quiz keeps its answer key on the server. CSV export uses stable question codes. No IP or user-agent is stored next to a health answer.

featured.name: Bot Arena
featured.stack: PYTHON · FASTAPI · REDPANDA · TIMESCALEDB · REACT · OLLAMA
featured.desc: Paper-trading arena where bots start with $1000 each and race the S&P 500. Ten rule-based strategies, a random monkey and local-LLM portfolio managers. There's a backtester without lookahead, a risk manager with a kill switch, and a live leaderboard. So far nothing has shown real skill, including the AI.

featured.name: Deal Hunter
featured.desc: Scrapes Bazoš and Aukro every ten minutes for underpriced graphics cards, laptops and disks. Prices each model against 60 days of listings, then a local LLM throws out broken or misleading ads, quoting the ad for every claim. Good deals land on my phone.

featured.name: Valcraft - Minecraft × Valheim
featured.desc: Play Valheim with Minecraft's mechanics. A hidden Minecraft instance handles movement, blocks, tools and TNT, and Valheim renders it all. Placed blocks become Valheim meshes, and digging reshapes Valheim's terrain.

featured.name: ReelGuard
featured.desc: Android app that limits Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok to a daily allowance, with a countdown while you watch. No internet permission and no dependencies.

featured.name: Home Camera AI Detection
featured.desc: Real-time monitoring with a Luxonis OAK-D LR depth camera. It detects people and vehicles and draws heatmaps. It also counts line crossings and watches zones like the property gate.

archive.name: Steam CZ Behavior Analysis
archive.desc: Semestral project at VŠE about ten years of Czech Steam user behavior. Changepoint detection and cohort analysis, plus seasonal decomposition. Comes with a paper and a presentation.

archive.name: Gemma - Discord Voice Bot
archive.desc: A bot that joins voice channels, listens with faster-whisper, asks a local LLM and answers out loud with Piper TTS. Self-hosted in an LXC container.

archive.name: rust-dns
archive.desc: DNS server from scratch in Rust, every byte parsed by hand with no DNS crates. A learning project, built stage by stage toward a caching, ad-blocking resolver for the homelab.

archive.name: Full-stack E-shop
archive.desc: E-shop with a Flask backend and a React frontend. Has JWT auth, a local cart and Stripe payments.

archive.name: Products REST API
archive.desc: Token-authenticated product API that syncs prices and stock from an external service. Runs in Docker, has tests, monitored with Grafana.

archive.name: Instagram Chat Analyzer
archive.desc: Offline tool that turns exported Instagram DM JSON into stats and plots. Made for myself.

archive.name: AC Automation
archive.desc: HVAC control with an ESP8266 and PWM DACs, hooked into Home Assistant, in a 3D-printed enclosure. It still runs.
